 Man of Tomorrow’s ‘Incredible’ Fight Scenes Teased by David Corenswet: ‘Really Up Their Game’
 COMINGSOON.net Follow Manoj Chekkilla Add to Preferred Sources Thu, November 19, 2026 at 4:37 PM UTC Photo Credit: DC Studios David Corenswet has teased the scale of Man of Tomorrow 's action sequences. The DCU star also shared his excitement that fans will get to see those scenes.
 Speaking with The Rich Eisen Show, Corenswet brought up the Superman sequel while discussing action sequences in his upcoming sports drama Mr. Irrelevant. "Actually, in this movie, in the next Superman movie that we finished this summer, there are some incredible new flying and fights," he shared. "They really up their game there."
 Corenswet also revealed that these sequences were among his favorite parts of making the film. The actor said he is particularly excited for audiences to see them. He further explained that the scenes "were a lot of fun to shoot."
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The 33-year-old did not elaborate on what the scenes would include, but his comments suggest that the sequel's fight sequences will take things to another level.
 What else do we know about Man of Tomorrow so far?
 Man of Tomorrow takes place two years after its predecessor. The story forces Superman to team up with his overarching rival Lex Luthor ( Nicholas Hoult ) to face a much bigger threat from the alien android Brainiac (Lars Eidinger).
 Notable returning cast members include Rachel Brosnahan as Lois Lane, Isabela Merced as Hawkgirl, Nathan Fillion as Guy Gardner, and Edi Gathegi as Mister Terrific. Aaron Pierre will also appear as John Stewart , Earth's Green Lantern. Xolo Maridueña will appear as Blue Beetle, while Adria Arjona has been cast in an undisclosed role.
 With a large ensemble and a new supervillain, the sequel has plenty of action sequences that fit Corenswet's remarks. Man of Tomorrow will also mark the first DCU project under Skydance's leadership since James Gunn and Peter Safran left their roles as co-heads of DC Studios.
 Advertisement Advertisement Helmed by James Gunn, Man of Tomorrow arrives in theaters on July 9, 2027.
 Originally reported on SuperHeroHype .
